chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the prayer upon the deceased, he said:

You say Takbir, then send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), then you say: 'O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maid, I do not know of him except good, and You are more knowing of him than I am. O Allah, if he was a good-doer, increase in his goodness and accept from him; and if he was a bad-doer, forgive his sin and have mercy on him, and make his grave spacious, and make him among the companions of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)'.
Then you say the second Takbir and say: 'O Allah, if he was pure, purify him; and if he was erroneous, forgive him'.
Then you say the third Takbir and say: 'O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not test us after him'.

Then you say the fourth Takbir and say: 'O Allah, record him with You among the 'Illiyun, and succeed him among his offspring in the later generations, and make him among the companions of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)'.
Then you say the fifth Takbir and turn away (conclude the prayer).

key_terms.افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ: Make his grave spacious (expand the grave for comfort)
key_terms.الْغَابِرِينَ: The later generations/Those who come after

ai.seo_question: What are the specific supplications recited after each Takbir in the Shia funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi details the specific supplications (Duas) recited after each of the five Takbirs in the funeral prayer, highlighting the Shia emphasis on intercession and the deceased's connection to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Scholarly tradition notes that these supplications reflect a balanced approach, invoking mercy for both the righteous and the sinners, while also seeking protection for the living from the trials of death. The inclusion of 'Illyeen' and 'Khalifah' underscores the theological concepts of high ranks in Paradise and inheritance of legacy.
